cues.en: This is my second video about radiative cooling paint, and I think my original explanation was less intuitive than it could have been.
cues.zh: 这是我关于辐射制冷涂料的第二期视频，我觉得自己最初的解释还不够直观。

cues.en: Paint of this kind has two essential features.
cues.zh: 这类涂料有两个核心特性。

cues.en: First, it needs to be extremely
cues.zh: 首先，它必须极其

cues.en: white so that visible light bounces off of it and is not absorbed as heat.
cues.zh: 洁白，这样可见光就会被直接反射出去，而不会被吸收转化成热量。

cues.en: Therefore, it absorbs very little sunlight which would otherwise warm it up.
cues.zh: 因此，它吸收的太阳光非常少，而这些阳光原本会使它升温。

cues.en: The other feature is that it must radiate a particular wavelength of infrared light that passes straight through the earth's atmosphere without being absorbed.
cues.zh: 另一个特征是，它必须辐射特定波长的红外光，这种光能直接穿过地球大气层而不被吸收。

cues.en: All materials emit their heat as infrared light, which is why an infrared camera works.
cues.zh: 所有材料都会以红外光的形式散发热量，这就是红外摄像机的工作原理。

cues.en: And typically, take note because this part is important,
cues.zh: 通常要注意，因为这部分很重要，

cues.en: an object will easily absorb the same spectrum of infrared light that it emits.
cues.zh: 一个物体会容易吸收与它所发射的相同光谱的红外光。

cues.en: If that spectrum is absorbed by the atmosphere,
cues.zh: 如果那个光谱被大气层吸收，

cues.en: it means that the atmosphere will, in return,
cues.zh: 这意味着大气层反过来会

cues.en: emit the same spectrum of light back toward the earth, warming all objects that easily absorb that same wavelength.
cues.zh: 向地球发射相同光谱的光，从而温暖所有容易吸收相同波长的物体。

cues.en: If our paint releases light that does not react with the atmosphere, it will fly directly off into the coldness of outer space.
cues.zh: 如果我们的涂料释放的光不与大气层发生反应，它就会直接飞向寒冷的外太空。

cues.en: And because the atmosphere does not emit the same wavelength back at the paint,
cues.zh: 而且因为大气层不会向涂料发射相同波长的光，

cues.en: the energy gained versus energy lost does not balance out. The paint gets colder than the air around it.
cues.zh: 获得的能量与失去的能量无法平衡。涂料会比周围的空气更冷。

cues.en: Note that this does not violate any laws of thermodynamics.
cues.zh: 请注意，这并不违反任何热力学定律。

cues.en: It only works because outer space is very cold and heat naturally flows from hot things into cold things.
cues.zh: 它能起作用只是因为外太空非常寒冷，而热量自然从热的物体流向冷的物体。

cues.en: The one feature that makes a cooling paint seem like magic is that it ignores the atmosphere,
cues.zh: 让冷却涂料看起来像魔法的一个特征是，它无视大气层，

cues.en: which usually is bouncing our own heat back at us, so that we don't realize how cold it is a few miles above our heads.
cues.zh: 而大气层通常会把我们自己的热量反弹回来，所以我们意识不到头顶几英里处有多冷。

cues.en: This paint only works when it's facing the sky. Hence its name, radiative sky cooling paint.
cues.zh: 这种涂料只有在朝向天空时才有效。因此得名：辐射天空冷却涂料。

cues.en: This is amazing to me. And you can push the temperature even colder by bringing the painted sample into the shade also, as long as it still has a clear view of the sky.

cues.en: Now, before anyone goes painting their whole house with this stuff, this is a relatively fragile
cues.zh: 不过，在有人拿这东西把整栋房子都刷上之前，要先说明：这是一种相对脆弱的

cues.en: coating

cues.zh: 以免把冷却潜力浪费在外部空气上，同时也保持清洁。

cues.en: I think the best practical way to use this is not going to be as a typical exterior building paint. In the long term, we'll have to design various items and applications
cues.zh: 我认为，最实际的用法不会是像普通建筑外墙涂料那样。长期来看，我们必须设计各种物品和应用，

cues.en: that are intentional about using a radiative coating effectively.
cues.zh: 让它们有意识地有效利用辐射涂层。

cues.zh: 当然，我自己也会着手这项研究，先从之前提到的冷却面板开始。

cues.en: So in my first video on this topic, we explored a version of this paint that used barium sulfate as the pigment.
cues.zh: 在我关于这个主题的第一个视频中，我们探索了这种涂料的一个版本，它使用硫酸钡作为颜料。

cues.en: Barium sulfate emits infrared light that the atmosphere is transparent toward, and the best results that have been reported in scientific literature have used this as the pigment.
cues.zh: 硫酸钡会发出大气层可以透过的红外光，而科学文献中报道的最佳结果都使用了它作为颜料。

cues.en: As you can see, this took me a while. To make calcium carbonate, the first step in all cases was to react sodium carbonate with calcium chloride.

cues.en: Sodium carbonate is sold as washing soda in just about every hardware and grocery store. But don't get it confused with baking soda. Baking soda, if necessary, can be converted into washing soda by heating it in an oven at 200 degrees Celsius for about an hour.
cues.zh: 几乎每家五金店和杂货店都卖洗涤碱，也就是碳酸钠。但别把它和小苏打弄混。必要时，可以把小苏打放进烤箱，以 200 摄氏度加热约一小时，将其转化为洗涤碱。

cues.en: But it's better to just buy pure washing soda to begin with.
cues.zh: 但最好一开始就买纯洗涤碱。

cues.zh: 氯化钙，这个反应中的另一种化学物质，

cues.zh: 按50磅袋装出售，用途多样。

cues.zh: 许多论文建议使用起始原料的极稀溶液。

cues.en: which disqualifies about 99%
cues.zh: 这就排除了约99%

cues.en: of all the published research on this subject.
cues.zh: 关于这个主题的所有已发表研究。

cues.en: One exception was this paper, which used fairly high concentrations of calcium chloride and sodium carbonate. And what really stood out was their use of sodium citrate,
cues.zh: 一个例外是这篇论文，它使用了相当高浓度的氯化钙和碳酸钠。真正引人注目的是他们使用了柠檬酸钠，

cues.en: which for some reason helped in the formation of spheres.
cues.zh: 不知为何这有助于球体的形成。

cues.en: At first, I did not pay for access to read this paper, so just going off of what I could see in the abstract,
cues.zh: 起初，我没有付费获取阅读这篇论文的权限，所以只能根据摘要中能看到的内容，

cues.en: I started playing with sodium citrate as an additive to this reaction.
cues.zh: 我开始尝试将柠檬酸钠作为这个反应的添加剂。

cues.en: This was super interesting. Sodium citrate, it turns out, delays the formation of calcium carbonate.
cues.zh: 这非常有趣。事实证明，柠檬酸钠会延迟碳酸钙的形成。

cues.en: When you have a bunch of sodium citrate mixed in the same solution as the calcium chloride,
cues.zh: 当你在与氯化钙相同的溶液中混入大量柠檬酸钠时，

cues.en: when you then add the sodium carbonate,
cues.zh: 当你再加入碳酸钠时，

cues.en: everything turns into a gel.
cues.zh: 一切都会变成凝胶。

cues.en: It's really weird. Under a microscope, it looks like fabric.
cues.zh: 这真的很奇怪。在显微镜下，它看起来像织物。

cues.en: What's even stranger is over the course of the next few hours you start to be able to see tiny spheres growing out of this fabric. It's like stars growing in a microscopic nebula.
cues.zh: 更奇怪的是，在接下来的几个小时里，你开始能看到微小的球体从这织物中生长出来。就像恒星在微观星云中生长一样。

cues.en: So this method worked. After about twelve hours, all of the gel was consumed as the spheres grew and they all end up just about the same size.
cues.zh: 所以这个方法奏效了。大约十二小时后，所有凝胶都被消耗掉，球体不断生长，最终大小都差不多。

cues.en: This was with approximately a molar ratio of all three ingredients.
cues.zh: 这大约是所有三种成分的摩尔比。

cues.en: What I discovered is that by reducing the amount of sodium citrate, the crystallization reaction starts to go faster and faster.
cues.zh: 我发现，通过减少柠檬酸钠的用量，结晶反应会开始越来越快。

cues.en: Its primary function seems to be as a delaying agent.
cues.zh: 它的主要作用似乎是作为延迟剂。

cues.en: At a certain point, around 20% of the original sodium citrate concentration,
cues.zh: 在某个点上，大约是原始柠檬酸钠浓度的20%，

cues.en: we stop forming spheres and start to get other crystal shapes. But the reaction is still delayed enough that we can place a drop on a microscope slide and observe the crystals forming in real time.
cues.zh: 我们不再形成球体，开始得到其他晶体形状。但反应仍然被延迟得足够久，我们可以把一滴放在显微镜载玻片上，实时观察晶体形成。

cues.en: So I definitely learned some interesting things as a consequence of this paper. I ended up purchasing access to the full text, but it didn't turn out to provide much additional help.
cues.zh: 所以因为这篇论文，我确实学到了一些有趣的东西。我最终购买了全文的访问权限，但结果并没有提供太多额外帮助。

cues.en: The paper only made one size of sphere, and their discussion about the possibilities of why sodium citrate helps in the formation of spheres was not very conclusive.
cues.zh: 这篇论文只做出了一种大小的球体，而且他们关于柠檬酸钠为何有助于球体形成的可能性的讨论并不很有结论性。

cues.en: In any case, using sodium citrate allowed me to make microspheres with the most consistent results yet.
cues.zh: 无论如何，使用柠檬酸钠让我做出了迄今为止结果最一致的微球。

cues.en: This was a necessary step before I can move on to further experiments to hopefully learn how to control their size.
cues.zh: 这是我继续后续实验前必须完成的一步，希望借此学会如何控制它们的大小。

cues.en: Immediately upon my first successful results, I tried changing the reaction temperature to make smaller and larger spheres.
cues.zh: 第一次成功之后，我立刻尝试改变反应温度，以制备更小和更大的球体。

cues.en: That's how barium sulfate spheres are made into different sizes, but calcium is not so cooperative.
cues.zh: 硫酸钡球体就是这样制成不同尺寸的，但钙就没那么配合了。

cues.en: The reaction only worked in a range between about five and thirty degrees Celsius,
cues.zh: 反应只在约五到三十摄氏度之间才有效，

cues.en: and the size of spheres was very inconsistent.
cues.zh: 而且球体的大小非常不一致。

cues.en: The size definitely did not correlate with a change in temperature.
cues.zh: 尺寸显然与温度变化没有相关性。

cues.en: Much of the time, no spheres were made at all, which was very confusing.
cues.zh: 大多数时候根本形不成球体，这让人非常困惑。

cues.en: I also attempted to change stirring speed, stirring duration,
cues.zh: 我还尝试改变搅拌速度、搅拌时间，

cues.en: and the concentration
cues.zh: 以及反应物的

cues.en: of the reactants
cues.zh: 浓度，

cues.en: to see if any of those things would make a difference in particle size.
cues.zh: 看看这些因素是否会影响颗粒尺寸。

cues.en: Again, inconsistent results.
cues.zh: 结果同样不一致。

cues.en: For most of these tests, I was using a molar equivalent of sodium citrate compared to the calcium chloride in the solution, which meant that the crystal growth was very slow.
cues.zh: 在这些测试的大部分中，我使用的柠檬酸钠相对于溶液中氯化钙的摩尔当量为一比一，这意味着晶体生长非常缓慢。

cues.en: But this ratio had given me the most reliable results early on, so I stuck with it. This is one of my first tests comparing the size of spheres made to the amount of time the solution was stirred.
cues.zh: 但这个比例在早期给了我最可靠的结果，所以我坚持用它。这是我最早的测试之一，比较了制成的球体尺寸与溶液搅拌时间的关系。

cues.en: You can see that right toward the end at the forty minute and one hour mark that the size becomes slightly smaller, but it stays the same until then.
cues.zh: 可以看到，在接近末尾的四十分钟和一小时处，尺寸略微变小，但在此之前一直保持不变。

cues.en: My conclusion from this was that stirring time has some effect on size, but that it's not very effective.
cues.zh: 我的结论是，搅拌时间对尺寸有一定影响，但效果不太明显。

cues.en: That was a bad conclusion. It took me way too many failed experiments before came back and reconsidered
cues.zh: 那是个糟糕的结论。我做了太多失败的实验，才回过头重新考虑

cues.en: that this early test should not have been ruled out.
cues.zh: 这个早期测试本不该被排除。

cues.en: This mistake turned out for the best because I discovered more things in the meantime that helped refine the final process.
cues.zh: 这个错误反而带来了最好的结果，因为在此期间我发现了更多东西，帮助完善了最终工艺。

cues.en: One of the things I discovered is a way to make the starting solution self purifying.
cues.zh: 我发现的其中一点，是让起始溶液自我净化的一种方法。

cues.en: One issue with crystallization reactions is that the starting solutions need to be super clean because any speck of dust or contaminant will nucleate the growth of crystals in shapes that are not the ones we're looking for.
cues.zh: 结晶反应的一个问题是，起始溶液需要超级干净，因为任何一粒灰尘或污染物都会促使晶体以我们不想看到的形状成核生长。

cues.en: This is a particularly annoying problem when using calcium chloride
cues.zh: 使用氯化钙时，这个问题尤其烦人

cues.en: because this stuff reacts with c o two from the air to form calcium carbonate,
cues.zh: 因为这种物质会与空气中的二氧化碳反应，生成碳酸钙，

cues.en: the same stuff we're trying to make, but in a disorderly way that prevents the formation of spheres.
cues.zh: 这正是我们想制造的东西，但会以无序的方式生成，阻碍球体的形成。

cues.en: When I dissolve this calcium chloride in water, you can see that the solution is not clear.
cues.zh: 当我把这种氯化钙溶于水时，可以看到溶液并不清澈。

cues.en: This milky haze is made up of microscopic calcium carbonate crystals that have naturally formed as CO2 reacted with the chloride flakes while they were in storage.
cues.zh: 这种乳白色雾状物由微小的碳酸钙晶体组成，是氯化钙薄片在储存期间与二氧化碳反应自然形成的。

cues.en: If I used this solution immediately to make microspheres,
cues.zh: 如果我立即用这种溶液来制作微球，

cues.en: about half of the end product would instead be jagged misshapen chunks.
cues.zh: 大约一半的最终产品反而会是参差不齐、形状畸形的块状物。

cues.en: For a good result, you have to let this solution settle for about twelve hours before using it, and then very carefully pour the clean liquid off the top.
cues.zh: 为了获得良好效果，你必须让这个溶液静置约十二小时后再使用，然后非常小心地把上层清液倒出来。

cues.en: All of this can be avoided by swapping sodium citrate for citric acid.
cues.zh: 只要用柠檬酸代替柠檬酸钠，这一切都可以避免。

cues.en: Citric acid dissolves calcium carbonate, so we can see that if I take a little bit of citric acid dissolved in water and pour it into the calcium chloride solution,
cues.zh: 柠檬酸能溶解碳酸钙，所以我们可以看到，如果我取少量柠檬酸溶于水，倒入氯化钙溶液中，

cues.en: it turns crystal clear.
cues.zh: 它就会变得晶莹剔透。

cues.en: Citric acid dissolves all of the contaminants that would prevent the formation of spheres,
cues.zh: 柠檬酸能溶解所有会妨碍球体形成的杂质，

cues.en: and it performs the same function as sodium citrate
cues.zh: 而且它的作用与柠檬酸钠相同，

cues.en: because it actually turns into sodium citrate as soon as it mixes with the other chemical in this reaction,
cues.zh: 因为一旦它与这个反应中的另一种化学物质混合，它实际上就会变成柠檬酸钠，

cues.en: the washing soda, sodium carbonate.
cues.zh: 也就是洗涤碱，碳酸钠。

cues.en: We also get other benefits like citric acid being a common item in grocery stores because it's used for canning.
cues.zh: 我们还能获得其他好处，比如柠檬酸是杂货店里的常见商品，因为它被用于罐装保存。

cues.en: And because of its purifying effect, we no longer have to use high purity distilled
cues.zh: 而且由于其净化作用，我们不再需要使用高纯度蒸馏水

cues.en: or deionized water.
cues.zh: 或去离子水。

cues.en: I tried tap water, water from an in ground well, and even water from a dirty rain barrel, and it all worked just as well for making microspheres
cues.zh: 我试过自来水、地下井水，甚至脏雨水桶里的水，它们在制作微球时都同样有效，

cues.en: because of the self cleaning effect of the citric acid.
cues.zh: 这要归功于柠檬酸的自清洁效应。

cues.en: Now eventually, I made my way back to testing stirring time as a means of controlling particle size.
cues.zh: 后来，我终于回过头来测试搅拌时间作为控制颗粒大小手段的效果。

cues.en: The reason this did not work very well the first time is because I was using so much sodium citrate that it delayed the reaction to the point that the first crystals didn't even nucleate until at least the forty minute mark.
cues.zh: 第一次效果不太好的原因是我用了太多柠檬酸钠，把反应延迟到了第一批晶体至少要到四十分钟才开始成核的程度。

cues.en: There's no reason to expect that stirring before that point would make much difference.
cues.zh: 在那之前搅拌，没理由指望会有多大区别。

cues.en: One final paper I'll mention is this one. This is by far the best article I found that explored the factors that change the size of these microspheres.
cues.zh: 最后要提的一篇论文就是这篇。这是我找到的、探讨改变这些微球尺寸因素的最好的一篇文章，遥遥领先。

cues.en: The authors used methods that I think add unnecessary
cues.zh: 作者用的方法我认为增加了不必要的

cues.en: complexity,
cues.zh: 复杂性，

cues.en: but their conclusions were super helpful.
cues.zh: 但他们的结论非常有用。

cues.en: First of all, they confirmed that temperature is not at all effective for size control,
cues.zh: 首先，他们证实了温度对尺寸控制完全无效，

cues.en: which was welcome confirmation of my own findings.
cues.zh: 这正好印证了我自己的发现，令人欣慰。

cues.en: Most importantly, and I'm embarrassed to have not realized this myself,
cues.zh: 最重要的是——说来惭愧，我自己居然没想到——

cues.en: this paper found that the most important factor that determines the size of the microspheres
cues.zh: 这篇论文发现，决定微球尺寸最重要的因素

cues.en: is the number of nucleation sites in the solution.
cues.zh: 是溶液中的成核位点数量。

cues.en: I should have realized this really early on as soon as I saw the spheres growing in the fabric like gel under my microscope,
cues.zh: 我早该意识到这一点的——早在显微镜下看到球体像凝胶一样在织物中生长时，

cues.en: and how that gel was consumed as the particles grew.
cues.zh: 以及看到凝胶随着颗粒生长而被消耗时，就该想到。

cues.en: Think about it. If you only have one sphere growing in this whole patch of gel, it's going to get enormous
cues.zh: 想想看。如果整片凝胶里只长一个球，它就会变得巨大，

cues.en: because it has so much material surrounding it that it can use to grow.
cues.zh: 因为周围有那么多材料可供它生长。

cues.en: On the other hand, if spheres start to grow from a whole bunch of nucleation points in the midst of this gel, they're going to start stealing resources from one another,
cues.zh: 反过来，如果球体从凝胶中大量成核点同时开始生长，它们就会互相抢夺资源，

cues.en: and by the time the crystal feedstock is depleted, they will still be quite small.
cues.zh: 等到晶体原料耗尽时，它们仍然相当小。

cues.en: It's a very simple concept,
cues.zh: 道理非常简单，

cues.en: and as soon as I read this paper, I knew why my first stirring tests had not worked and the solution to my problem.
cues.zh: 我一读到这篇论文，就明白了为什么最初的搅拌试验没成功，也找到了问题的解决办法。

cues.en: I need to be stirring the solution during the nucleation stage of the microspheres.
cues.zh: 在微球成核阶段，我得一直搅拌溶液。

cues.en: The agitation should create more nucleation points, and the more I stir during this stage, the smaller the resulting sphere should be.
cues.zh: 搅拌应该会产生更多成核点；在这个阶段搅拌得越多，生成的微球应该就越小。

cues.en: The other thing I can do is use less citrate so that the reaction occurs faster, and I don't have to wait an hour before the stirring starts to become effective.
cues.zh: 另一个办法是少用柠檬酸盐，让反应更快发生，这样我就不必等一个小时搅拌才开始见效。

cues.en: I did a fresh batch of tests now that I switched in the new ingredient citric acid and found an effective mixture to reliably make spheres.
cues.zh: 我换用新成分柠檬酸后重新做了一批测试，找到了能稳定生成微球的有效配比。

cues.en: I'll explain the details of that mixture in a moment. Here are the results of my first stirring test.
cues.zh: 我稍后会解释这个配比的细节。下面是我第一次搅拌测试的结果。

cues.en: For the first time, I was able to control the size of my microspheres
cues.zh: 我第一次能够控制微球的尺寸

cues.en: very reliably.
cues.zh: 非常可靠。

cues.en: And even better, we know why this method works.
cues.zh: 更棒的是，我们知道这个方法为什么有效。

cues.en: If I want even smaller particles, I know the key is to use even more agitation,
cues.zh: 如果我想得到更小的颗粒，我知道关键在于使用更强的搅拌，

cues.en: generate even more nucleation sites during the initial stages, and we'll get yet smaller spheres,
cues.zh: 在初始阶段产生更多成核位点，我们就会得到更小的微球，

cues.en: perhaps even down into the nanoscale.
cues.zh: 甚至可能小到纳米尺度。

cues.en: Well, that was a deeper dive than I expected to get into, but now you know some details about what we're actually doing here. Actually, I haven't even explained why I think spheres are formed instead of other shapes. There's a lot of technical information that maybe I'll talk about in a supplementary video. It's about time I present the final recipe for making this pigment.
cues.zh: 嗯，这次深入得比我预想的多，但现在你们已经了解了一些我们实际在做的细节。其实，我还没解释为什么我认为会形成微球而不是其他形状。有很多技术信息，也许我会在补充视频里讲。差不多该展示制作这种颜料的最终配方了。

cues.en: To make everything as easy as possible to follow, all the ingredients are dissolved in a one to 10 ratio with water.
cues.zh: 为了让整个过程尽可能容易跟上，所有原料都按一比十的比例溶于水中。

cues.en: The basic mixture, can be scaled up or down, is 20 of sodium carbonate dissolved in 200
cues.zh: 基础混合液可以按比例放大或缩小，即20份碳酸钠溶于200份

cues.en: of water,
cues.zh: 水中，

cues.en: 10 of calcium chloride dissolved in 100
cues.zh: 10份氯化钙溶于100份

cues.en: of water, and three grams of citric acid dissolved in 30 milliliters of water.
cues.zh: 水中，以及3克柠檬酸溶于30毫升水中。

cues.en: The mixture of citric acid is combined with the calcium chloride solution which causes it to go clear as the acid dissolves any impurities.
cues.zh: 将柠檬酸混合液与氯化钙溶液混合，随着酸溶解掉杂质，溶液会变得清澈。

cues.en: Now the liquids in these containers must be between ten and twenty degrees Celsius before mixing them, ideally right in the middle at 15 degrees.
cues.zh: 现在，这些容器中的液体在混合前必须处于10到20摄氏度之间，最好正好在中间的15度。

cues.en: A small kitchen thermometer is perfect for measuring this, and the chemicals we're using are not at all dangerous for food contact, so if necessary, you can cool the solutions in a refrigerator.
cues.zh: 一个小型厨房温度计就非常适合测量这个，而且我们使用的化学品对食品接触完全没有危险，所以如有必要，你可以把溶液放进冰箱冷却。

cues.en: Once the liquids are within the 10 to 20 degrees Celsius boundary,
cues.zh: 一旦液体处于10到20摄氏度的范围内，

cues.en: all we need to do is mix them together with vigorous stirring.
cues.zh: 我们只需要用力搅拌将它们混合在一起。

cues.en: I used a magnetic stir plate for all of my earlier experiments,
cues.zh: 我 earlier 的所有实验都用的是磁力搅拌器，

cues.en: but I think a better tool to use
cues.zh: 但我认为更好的工具

cues.en: is a blender,
cues.zh: 是搅拌机，

cues.en: particularly because this will be useful for a second purpose later in the paint making process.
cues.zh: 特别是因为这在 later 的制漆过程中还有第二个用途。

cues.en: You can also get these super cheap at second hand shops, often for less than $10.
cues.zh: 你也可以在二手店超便宜地买到这些，通常不到10美元。

cues.en: The calcium chloride and citric acid solution goes in first, and at this point, we need to be ready with a timer.
cues.zh: 先倒入氯化钙和柠檬酸溶液，此时我们需要准备好计时器。

cues.en: Side note, because this blender holds a lot of liquid, I have tripled the basic recipe size so that it fills more of the container and will not splash as much when I turn the blades on.
cues.zh: 补充一点，因为这个搅拌机容量很大，我把基础配方量加了三倍，这样能装得更满，开刀片时也不容易溅出来。

cues.en: Now we can set this blender at the lowest speed, and when ready, remove the lid and pour in the second solution of sodium carbonate.
cues.zh: 现在我们把搅拌机调到最低速，准备好后打开盖子，倒入第二份碳酸钠溶液。

cues.en: Right then, we start the timer.
cues.zh: 好，开始计时。

cues.en: The largest sphere size will be made with about one minute of blending.
cues.zh: 最大球径大约搅拌一分钟就能做出来。

cues.en: Here again are the results from my tests with a stir plate. A blender is much more powerful, which means you can expect the particle size to shrink even more dramatically
cues.zh: 这里再次展示我用磁力搅拌器测试的结果。搅拌机功率大得多，所以你可以预期粒径会缩小得更明显

cues.en: for each increment of stirring time.
cues.zh: 随着每增加一段搅拌时间。

cues.en: I'll stop the blender after one minute for our first batch of the largest particle size.
cues.zh: 第一批最大粒径的搅拌一分钟后我会停下搅拌机。

cues.en: For the time being, this mix can be poured into a separate container while we get ready for another batch.
cues.zh: 目前这批可以先倒进另一个容器，我们准备做下一批。

cues.en: Cleaning between batches is really easy because our ingredients are dissolved by acid.
cues.zh: 批次之间清洗非常容易，因为我们的原料能被酸溶解。

cues.en: Put the container back on the blender, pour in a splash of vinegar and some water to dilute it, and turn the blender on. Everything will be clean and ready to use again within a few seconds.
cues.zh: 把容器装回搅拌机，倒一点醋和一些水稀释，然后开机。几秒钟内一切就干净了，可以再次使用。

cues.en: Now our largest microspheres
cues.zh: 现在我们最大的微球

cues.en: are starting to settle out in this container.
cues.zh: 开始在这个容器里沉淀。

cues.en: For a high density pigment, we now need a smaller size to mix with them. If we go back to the percentage bar I used earlier when talking about sphere packing,
cues.zh: 对于高密度颜料，现在我们需要更小的粒径来和它们混合。如果回到我之前讲球体堆积时用的百分比条，

cues.en: we can see that the largest size takes up 65%
cues.zh: 可以看到最大粒径占了65%

cues.en: of the total volume, and the next size takes up 65%
cues.zh: 的总体积，而下一档粒径占了65%

cues.en: of the remaining volume.
cues.zh: 的剩余体积。

cues.en: If you ignore the empty space and just look at the ratio between these two parts, you can see that you only need about 25%
cues.zh: 如果忽略空隙，只看这两部分的比例，你会发现只需要大约25%

cues.en: small particles compared to the volume of the larger ones. In other words, you need three parts large particles for every one part of a smaller size.
cues.zh: 的小颗粒，相比大颗粒的体积。换句话说，每三份大颗粒需要一份小颗粒。

cues.en: So to make a whole bunch of pigment, we can repeat what we just did two more times so that we triple the amount of these large microspheres.
cues.zh: 所以，为了制作大量颜料，我们可以重复刚才的步骤两次，这样就能把大微球的数量增加到三倍。

cues.en: And then we run one more batch and make that one a smaller particle size by blending it longer for about five minutes.
cues.zh: 然后再运行一批，通过延长混合时间约五分钟，使这一批的颗粒尺寸更小。

cues.en: When the four batches are combined, it will be three parts large spheres and one part small to match the percentages of the scale.
cues.zh: 当四批合并时，将是三份大球和一份小球，以符合比例尺上的百分比。

cues.en: For the best results, can go one step further and increase the density to 95%
cues.zh: 为了获得最佳效果，可以更进一步，将密度提高到95%

cues.en: with a third size. The quantity should again be reduced to one third of the previous batch.
cues.zh: 使用第三种尺寸。数量应再次减少到前一批的三分之一。

cues.en: This mix should be blended for eight to ten minutes, which brings you well into the range of making nanoparticles.
cues.zh: 这种混合物应混合八到十分钟，这将使你完全进入制造纳米颗粒的范围。

cues.en: These are very small.
cues.zh: 这些非常小。

cues.en: So now I have five total batches,
cues.zh: 所以现在我一共有五批，

cues.en: and these three contain my largest particle size.
cues.zh: 其中这三批包含我最大的颗粒尺寸。

cues.en: This one is a medium size, and in this container are the very smallest microspheres.
cues.zh: 这一批是中等尺寸，而这个容器里是非常小的微球。

cues.en: Most of them have already settled to the bottom of the first three containers, so now we just need to wait about fifteen minutes for these ones to do the same thing.
cues.zh: 它们中的大多数已经沉降到前三个容器的底部，所以现在我们只需要等待大约十五分钟，让这些也做同样的事情。

cues.en: Once settled, the clear liquid can be poured off the top as waste.
cues.zh: 一旦沉降，清澈的液体可以从顶部倒掉作为废物。

cues.en: This contains lots of dissolved table salt, sodium citrate, and excess sodium carbonate,
cues.zh: 这里面有大量溶解的食盐、柠檬酸钠和过量的碳酸钠，

cues.en: all of which is nontoxic,
cues.zh: 这些物质都无毒，

cues.en: but we don't want it in our final product.
cues.zh: 但我们不想让它们留在最终产品里。

cues.en: The microsphere should then all be combined into one single container and topped off with fresh water.
cues.zh: 然后应把所有微球都合并到一个容器中，再加满清水。

cues.en: Over the course of a few minutes, everything will settle out again so the top can once again be poured out as waste and refilled with more water.
cues.zh: 几分钟后，所有东西会再次沉淀下来，这样就可以再把上层液体倒掉当作废液，并重新加满水。

cues.en: We'll do this two or three times to remove as much of the dissolved salts as we can, and then it's time to filter and collect our finished pigment.
cues.zh: 我们会重复两到三次，尽量去除更多溶解盐，然后就可以过滤并收集成品颜料了。

cues.en: Filtering nanoparticles
cues.zh: 过滤纳米颗粒

cues.en: can be pretty difficult because they either pass through or clog most filter paper. Fortunately, I found an easy solution. We will use capillary action to suck the water out of these particles through an ordinary piece of printer paper. First step is to take one of these disposable aluminum bread trays,
cues.zh: 可能相当困难，因为它们要么穿过大多数滤纸，要么把滤纸堵住。幸运的是，我找到了一个简单办法。我们将利用毛细作用，通过一张普通打印纸把这些颗粒中的水吸出来。第一步是拿一个这种一次性铝制面包托盘，

cues.en: cut an opening in the bottom, and line the tray with a paper towel. Now insert a piece of printer paper carefully folding it to line the sides. You don't want any part of the edge to be too low in the tray or the liquid will overflow.
cues.zh: 在底部开一个口，并在托盘里铺上纸巾。现在插入一张打印纸，小心折叠使其贴合侧壁。不要让纸边的任何部分在托盘里太低，否则液体会溢出。

cues.en: And this is our filter. We can pour in the finished pigment and watch as the water drains out.
cues.zh: 这就是我们的过滤器。我们可以倒入成品颜料，看着水排出去。

cues.en: Because of the paper towel that lines the bottom of the tray, water is pulled through much more quickly and this only takes about fifteen minutes to drain.
cues.zh: 因为托盘底部铺了纸巾，水被吸出的速度快得多，排水只需要大约十五分钟。

cues.en: The paper becomes very fragile when wet, so don't stick a spoon in here and stir the pigment around, or you could cause a tear when you touch the sides.
cues.zh: 纸张一旦弄湿就会变得很脆弱，所以不要把勺子伸进去搅拌颜料，否则碰到边缘时可能会把纸撕破。

cues.en: Once fully drained, I recommend refilling this one more time with distilled water to pull out the last bit of dissolved contaminants.
cues.zh: 完全排干后，我建议再用蒸馏水灌满一次，把最后一点溶解的污染物冲出来。

cues.en: Finally, the whole tray can go right into a toaster oven set to stay on at about 200 degrees Fahrenheit or 100 Celsius for about two hours with the door open to let out steam.
cues.zh: 最后，把整个托盘直接放进烤箱，设置在约 200 华氏度或 100 摄氏度，保持约两小时，并打开烤箱门排出蒸汽。

cues.en: And here is the finished pigment dry and on the filter. This can be carefully crumbled and poured into a plastic bag for storage.
cues.zh: 这就是最后得到的干燥颜料，已经附着在滤纸上。小心地把它捏碎，再倒进塑料袋中储存。

cues.en: I recommend wearing a dust mask for this step or doing it outdoors.
cues.zh: 这一步建议戴上防尘口罩，或者在室外进行。

cues.en: Pure calcium carbonate is not particularly dangerous because your body chemistry can actually dissolve it, But this powder is really dusty, and a mask is an easy precaution.
cues.zh: 纯碳酸钙并不是特别危险，因为人体化学环境实际上可以将其溶解；但这种粉末非常容易扬尘，戴口罩是个简单的预防措施。

cues.en: That's all there is to it to make this high density cooling pigment.
cues.zh: 制作这种高密度冷却颜料就是这么简单。

cues.en: It's about a five or ten minute process to measure the ingredients for each batch, get them blended, and then clean out the blender for the next one. About a half hour in total to get all the batches made for each particle size,
cues.zh: 每批只需大约五到十分钟，就能完成原料称量、混合，以及清洗搅拌机，为下一批做准备。所有粒径的批次加起来，大约半小时就能全部完成，

cues.en: and then the settling, filtering, and drying process can be done in the background while you work on other things.
cues.zh: 然后沉降、过滤和干燥可以在后台进行，同时你可以处理其他事情。

cues.en: It really doesn't take a lot of effort, and if you want to make more, just switch in some bigger equipment.
cues.zh: 这确实不费什么力气；如果想做更多，只要换用更大的设备即可。

cues.en: You can make four or five kilograms at a time with a paddle mixer and a garbage can.
cues.zh: 用桨式搅拌机和垃圾桶，一次可以制作四到五公斤。

cues.en: By the way, you can expect to end up with about eight grams of calcium carbonate microspheres
cues.zh: 顺便说一句，每使用10克氯化钙作为起始原料，

cues.en: for every 10 grams of calcium chloride used in the starting ingredients.
cues.zh: 预计最终能得到大约8克碳酸钙微球。

cues.en: That's about a 90% yield compared to the theoretical maximum,
cues.zh: 相比理论最大值，产率约为90%，

cues.en: which is pretty good.
cues.zh: 这相当不错了。

cues.en: So let's look at this under a microscope,
cues.zh: 让我们在显微镜下看看，

cues.en: and hopefully we'll be able to see how the particles come together in a high density configuration.
cues.zh: 希望能看到颗粒如何以高密度构型聚集在一起。

cues.en: And that's exactly what we see.
cues.zh: 这正是我们所看到的。

cues.en: All the gaps between large objects are filled in with smaller ones. That means that when we're counting on this pigment to radiate its heat away as a particular wavelength of infrared light,
cues.zh: 大物体之间的所有空隙都被较小的颗粒填充。这意味着，当我们依靠这种颜料以特定波长的红外光辐射热量时，

cues.en: every microscopic
cues.zh: 我们涂料的每一个微观

cues.en: area of our paint will be jam packed with particles that can do so.
cues.zh: 区域都会密布能够做到这一点的颗粒。

cues.en: Very little wasted space between them.
cues.zh: 它们之间几乎没有浪费的空间。

cues.en: So this high density pigment, which can now be easily made at home,
cues.zh: 所以这种高密度颜料，现在在家就能轻松制作，

cues.en: is by far the most important ingredient in a sky cooling paint.
cues.zh: 是天空辐射制冷涂料中最重要的成分。

cues.en: It's possible that this could be mixed with all sorts of different off the shelf products to make coatings that can reach sub ambient temperatures.
cues.zh: 有可能将其与各种现成产品混合，制成能达到低于环境温度的涂层。

cues.en: That will require further testing.
cues.zh: 这需要进一步测试。

cues.en: As it stands right now, I only know of one mixture that definitely works,
cues.zh: 就目前而言，我只知道一种确定有效的混合物，

cues.en: which uses the same method detailed in my previous video on this subject.
cues.zh: 它使用了我之前关于这个主题的视频中详述的相同方法。

cues.en: That is using a base of dissolved acrylic with a special effect that allows the finished coating to scatter light using the same properties
cues.zh: 那就是使用溶解丙烯酸作为基底，并采用一种特殊效果，使最终涂层能够利用与雪相同的特性

cues.en: as snow.
cues.zh: 来散射光线。

cues.en: To make the liquid base for our pigment, I start with a beaker of acetone.
cues.zh: 为了制作颜料的液体基底，我先准备一烧杯丙酮。

cues.en: For every 110
milliliters of acetone,
cues.zh: 毫升丙酮，

cues.en: we will add 12 milliliters
cues.zh: 我们加入12毫升

cues.en: of water.
cues.zh: 水。

cues.en: Make sure this is fresh acetone,
cues.zh: 确保这是新鲜的丙酮，

cues.en: not more than a few years old. Otherwise, it will already have absorbed water from the air, which will throw the measurement off.
cues.zh: 存放不超过几年。否则，它已经从空气中吸收了水分，这会干扰测量。

cues.en: With the water mixed in, I then add 10 grams of acrylic and seal the opening tightly with a piece of foil.
cues.zh: 混入水后，我加入10克丙烯酸，并用锡纸紧紧封住开口。

cues.en: Last step is to mark the beaker, so you know exactly how full it is at the start. So if any acetone evaporates,
cues.zh: 最后一步是标记烧杯，这样你就知道起始时的确切液位。这样如果有些丙酮蒸发了，

cues.en: you can refill it to this line.
cues.zh: 你可以加到这个线。

cues.en: The acrylic pieces are literally shards of broken acrylic windows,
cues.zh: 这些丙烯酸块其实是破碎的丙烯酸窗户碎片，

cues.en: plexiglass.
cues.zh: 有机玻璃。

cues.en: You can get scraps of this for free if you call a few hardware stores that do glass cutting because inevitably they end up with thin little strips left over from cutting acrylic windows.
cues.zh: 如果你打电话给几家做玻璃切割的五金店，可以免费得到这些边角料，因为他们切割丙烯酸窗户时不可避免地会剩下细长条。

cues.en: Usually, these just get thrown away unless someone like me shows up and asks to have them.
cues.zh: 通常，这些就直接扔掉了，除非像我这样的人出现并要求拿走它们。

cues.en: The acrylic will slowly dissolve in the acetone over a few days, but you can shorten this process to a few hours if you put it on a hot plate at a really low temperature,
cues.zh: 丙烯酸会在几天内慢慢溶解在丙酮中，但如果你放在低温加热板上，

cues.en: about one ten Fahrenheit 43 Celsius.
cues.zh: 大约华氏110度，摄氏43度，可以缩短到几小时。

cues.en: By using a water bath, it makes it much easier to hold the temperature steady.
cues.zh: 用水浴可以更容易保持温度稳定。

cues.en: Now if I had dissolved the acrylic in pure acetone,
cues.zh: 现在，如果我把丙烯酸溶解在纯丙酮中，

cues.en: when it dries, it would once again turn clear.
cues.zh: 干燥后，它会再次变透明。

cues.en: However, because I added water to this mixture, the water is going to stay behind as tiny droplets in the plastic until after the acetone evaporates.
cues.zh: 然而，因为我加了水到这个混合物中，水会以微小液滴形式留在塑料里，直到丙酮蒸发后。

cues.en: The water will evaporate later, leaving behind millions of tiny hollow spaces in the acrylic that scatter light.
cues.zh: 水分之后会蒸发，在亚克力中留下数百万微小的中空空间，从而散射光线。

cues.en: This makes the formerly transparent
cues.zh: 这使得原本透明的

cues.en: layer of plastic transform into a very bright white,
cues.zh: 塑料层变成非常明亮的白色，

cues.en: using the same effect that makes snow appear white, even though snow is made from transparent ice.
cues.zh: 利用的是让雪看起来呈白色的同一种效应，尽管雪是由透明的冰构成的。

cues.en: This will give us a free increase in the brightness of our paint and the effect works even better once we start adding pigment.
cues.zh: 这会免费提升我们涂料的亮度，而且一旦开始加入颜料，效果还会更好。

cues.en: This also increases the flexibility of the final coating because it gives the paint a microscopic foam like structure that is able to more easily deform without developing cracks.
cues.zh: 这还增加了最终涂层的柔韧性，因为它赋予涂料一种微观泡沫状结构，能更容易地变形而不产生裂纹。

cues.en: The application method that I currently use for this paint actually does not work if water is not added. Pure acrylic buckles and peels in giant pieces as it dries, but the mixture with water holds strong.
cues.zh: 我目前用于这种涂料的涂布方法，如果不加水其实行不通。纯亚克力干燥时会大片起皱和剥落，但加水混合后就能保持牢固。

cues.en: When I make this paint from scratch, I usually prepare the acrylic mix first so that it's ready to use by the time I'm finished making the pigment. If you do the math on this mixture, there's about one gram of acrylic dissolved in every 12 milliliters
cues.zh: 我从头制作这种涂料时，通常先准备好亚克力混合液，这样等我做完颜料时它就能直接用了。算一下这个混合液的比例，大约每一克亚克力溶解在每12毫升

cues.en: of liquid to which we will need to add seven grams of pigment.
cues.zh: 液体中，对此我们需要加入七克颜料。

cues.en: This mixture can of course be scaled up, so since I have 120
cues.zh: 这个混合液当然可以按比例放大，所以既然我有120

cues.en: milliliters of the acrylic mix here, I will need 70 grams of the pigment. For 1.2 liters you would need 700 grams, which would make about two liters of paint in total because the volume increases when the pigment is added.
cues.zh: 毫升的亚克力混合液，我就需要70克颜料。对于1.2升，你需要700克，总共能做出约两升涂料，因为加入颜料后体积会增加。

cues.en: One of the best things about using this microsphere pigment is that it mixes into a paint really easily.
cues.zh: 使用这种微球颜料最大的好处之一是，它很容易混入涂料中。

cues.en: You don't have to use any power mixing to get this to distribute through the liquid. It can be stirred in by hand.
cues.zh: 你不需要用任何电动搅拌就能让它均匀分布到液体里，手动搅拌就行。

cues.en: Now if you washed the pigment extremely well during the settling and filtering process,
cues.zh: 如果你在沉降和过滤过程中把颜料洗得非常干净，

cues.en: there should be no clumps that take more than light pressure to fully disintegrate.
cues.zh: 那应该不会有需要用力才能完全打散的结块。

cues.en: But chances are you may not do a perfect job filtering which will result in hard clumps distributed throughout the powder.
cues.zh: 但很可能你的过滤做得不够完美，结果粉末里会分布着一些硬结块。

cues.en: These are caused by water soluble contaminants like table salt or leftover sodium carbonate that was still in the powder when it went into the oven to dry.
cues.zh: 这些结块是由水溶性污染物造成的，比如食盐或残留的碳酸钠，它们在粉末进烤箱干燥时还留在里面。

cues.en: When the water evaporates,
cues.zh: 当水分蒸发时，

cues.en: these contaminants crystallize in between the microspheres
cues.zh: 这些污染物在微球之间结晶，

cues.en: gluing some of them together.
cues.zh: 把其中一些粘在一起。

cues.en: The good news is that these are really easy to deal with using the blender that made this pigment in the first place.
cues.zh: 好消息是，用最初制作这种颜料的搅拌机就能轻松解决这些问题。

cues.en: The powder is put right into the blender dry so that the blades can break up any water soluble crystals and the clumps will not be able to reform.
cues.zh: 把粉末直接干着放进搅拌机，让刀片打碎任何水溶性晶体，结块就无法重新形成。

cues.en: You want to be careful doing this for the sake of the blender because without liquid the blades can easily overheat
cues.zh: 这么做时要小心保护搅拌机，因为没有液体时刀片很容易过热，

cues.en: and damage the seal that keeps this container watertight.
cues.zh: 损坏保持容器密封防水的密封圈。

cues.en: Only blend for about a minute at a time on low speed and then let the container cool off before turning it on again.
cues.zh: 每次只以低速搅拌约一分钟，然后让容器冷却后再重新启动。

cues.en: After four or five cycles the powder should be completely smooth and ready to use. The blender, by the way, won't cause any damage to the microspheres.
cues.zh: 经过四五个循环后，粉末应该完全细腻，可以使用了。顺便说一下，搅拌机不会对微球造成任何损伤。

cues.en: Compared to their microscopic size, the blades in this are about as blunt as my forehead,
cues.zh: 相比它们微观的尺寸，里面的刀片大概跟我的额头一样钝，

cues.en: not nearly sharp enough to slice anything in half.
cues.zh: 远不够锋利，无法把任何东西切成两半。

cues.en: So now the acrylic mix is ready, the pigment is lump free, and we can mix these together.
cues.zh: 现在丙烯酸混合液准备好了，颜料也没有结块，我们可以把它们混合在一起。

cues.en: Seven grams of pigment for every 12 milliliters of liquid.
cues.zh: 每12毫升液体配7克颜料。

cues.en: This should only take about thirty seconds to a minute of stirring before the microspheres are evenly distributed and this starts to look like paint.
cues.zh: 这大概只需要搅拌30秒到1分钟，微球就能均匀分布，看起来就像油漆了。

cues.en: The acetone in this is going to evaporate really quickly, so as soon as I'm done mixing, I'll cover this with my foil again until I'm ready to use it. While I mix this, we're gonna take a pause here for this video's sponsor.
cues.zh: 里面的丙酮会很快挥发，所以我一搅拌完，就会再次用铝箔盖住，直到准备使用。在我搅拌的同时，我们要暂停一下，介绍一下本视频的赞助商。

cues.en: Well, with this project requiring so many variations on experiments,
cues.zh: 这个项目需要在实验上做很多变体，

cues.en: I found myself wishing I had some basic programming skills to help analyze the data.
cues.zh: 我发现自己希望能有一些基础编程技能来帮助分析数据。

cues.en: My younger brother is actually a professional physicist, and he's told me a few times that I would benefit from learning the programming language Python.
cues.zh: 我弟弟其实是一名职业物理学家，他跟我说过好几次，学习编程语言Python会对我有好处。

cues.en: So I've finally started doing that using a course on brilliant.org.
cues.zh: 所以我终于开始在brilliant.org上通过一门课程来学了。

cues.en: Brilliant is seriously the best for learning math, science, and computer science because their courses teach through interaction.
cues.zh: Brilliant绝对是学习数学、科学和计算机科学的最佳选择，因为他们的课程通过互动来教学。

cues.en: You get to play with the problems on screen in a way that helps you to understand a subject from the inside out. It prevents a common problem that I've experienced in my own education
cues.zh: 你可以在屏幕上动手操作这些问题，从而帮助你由内而外地理解一个主题。它能避免我在自己受教育过程中经历过的一个常见问题

cues.en: where I learn a new subject, but I don't really understand why one solution works and another fails.
cues.zh: 就是学了一个新主题，但并不真正理解为什么一种解法有效，而另一种却失败。

cues.en: That seems like a really shallow education. I wanna know why something works, not just that it does.
cues.zh: 那看起来像是非常肤浅的教育。我想知道某个东西为什么有效，而不仅仅是它确实有效。

cues.en: Isn't that right, Mose?
cues.zh: 对不对，Mose？

cues.en: He agrees.
cues.zh: 他同意了。

cues.en: Now this is where I need to confess that calling this mixture a paint is playing pretty loose with the definition of the word.
cues.zh: 现在我得坦白，把这个混合物称为“油漆”，是对这个词定义相当宽松的用法。

cues.en: It doesn't spread well with a brush, and I've yet to perfect a way of applying this with a paint sprayer.
cues.zh: 它用刷子不太好涂开，而且我还没完善出用喷漆器来喷涂它的方法。

cues.en: The closest I've come to spraying this on is with a hand squeezed chemical spray bottle,
cues.zh: 我最接近喷涂它的方式，是用手捏式的化学喷雾瓶，

cues.en: and then it comes out less like a spray and more like coarse drops which self level on the surface.
cues.zh: 然后它喷出来不太像喷雾，更像是粗糙的液滴，会在表面自流平。

cues.en: This actually works reasonably well and liquid has enough viscosity to stick even to non level surfaces.
cues.zh: 这个方法其实相当有效，液体有足够的黏性，连不平整的表面也能附着。

cues.en: You can see that I was able to paint an aluminum tube with this method for an experiment that may or may not make it into a future video.
cues.zh: 可以看到，我用这种方法给一根铝管上了涂层，这是为了一个实验，至于这个实验能不能出现在以后的视频里还不一定。

cues.en: Because of the water included in this coating that gives it a foam like structure,
cues.zh: 由于涂层中含有水，使它形成了类似泡沫的结构，

cues.en: it's able to be applied in extremely thick single layers,
cues.zh: 所以可以一次性涂得非常厚，

cues.en: even up to several millimeters at a time. When it dries, will shrink down to about half of its thickness.
cues.zh: 甚至一次能涂到几毫米厚。干燥后会收缩到大约一半的厚度。

cues.en: I think half a millimeter is probably close to the ideal thickness to aim for in the dry state.
cues.zh: 我觉得干燥状态下，半毫米大概是比较理想的厚度目标。

cues.en: You won't hurt anything by applying a thicker coating, but then of course it's a waste of materials if you could have spread it over a larger area.
cues.zh: 涂得厚一点也不会有什么问题，但如果本来能铺到更大的面积上，那当然就浪费材料了。

cues.en: The most reliable application method that I've found so far is to use a large syringe.
cues.zh: 到目前为止，我找到的最可靠的涂覆方法是用一个大注射器。

cues.en: First, suck up the paint, shake the liquid down into the base of the syringe so you can purge any air bubbles from the tip, and then extrude it line by line on the surface.
cues.zh: 先吸取涂料，把液体往下甩到注射器底部，这样就能把针尖处的气泡排掉，然后一行一行地挤到表面上。

cues.en: You do get little ridges and uneven thicknesses between lines, but those get better with practice.
cues.zh: 行与行之间确实会出现小凸起和厚度不均，但多练练就会好一些。

cues.en: It seems like this would be a really silly way to apply a coating to a large surface,
cues.zh: 看起来用这种方法给大表面涂涂层挺傻的，

cues.en: but the more I try it, the less impractical it feels. You can buy really big 300 milliliter syringes which would hold plenty of paint for a very large cooling panel.
cues.zh: 但我越试越觉得它没那么不实用。你可以买到很大的300毫升注射器，装得下足够给一块超大散热板上涂的涂料。

cues.en: It would be better if we could find a flat tip for these syringes so that you could cover a wider area with each pass, and on that note I had a different idea which was to use a piping bag.
cues.zh: 如果能给这些注射器找到扁嘴喷头，每次涂抹就能覆盖更宽的区域；说到这个，我还有个不同的想法，就是用裱花袋。

cues.en: These of course are made for applying frosting to a cake, and you can get super wide nozzles for the end of the bag.
cues.zh: 当然，这些本来就是给蛋糕抹糖霜用的，而且裱花袋末端还能装上超宽喷嘴。

cues.en: The only problem is that you have to be much more particular about the consistency of your paint, because if it's too thin, it will pour out and make a huge mess. At the right consistency,
cues.zh: 唯一的问题是，你得对涂料的稠度讲究得多，因为太稀的话，它会流出来弄得一团糟。稠度合适时，

cues.en: this works really well to lay down wide sections at a time.
cues.zh: 这能很好地一次铺出较宽的区域。

cues.en: So those are a few ideas that I have successfully used to apply this coating so far.
cues.zh: 所以，这些就是我到目前为止成功用来涂这种涂层的几个思路。

cues.en: I obviously hope to develop a more standardized
cues.zh: 我当然希望将来能开发出更标准化的

cues.en: and convenient application method in the future, but at least we have several options in the meantime that definitely work even if they're a little bit strange.
cues.zh: 和更方便的施工方法，但至少在此期间我们有几种选择，虽然有点奇怪，但确实可行。

cues.en: Developing the calcium microsphere recipe is an enormous step forward in terms of making sky cooling paint accessible for the average person.
cues.zh: 开发出钙微球配方，是让普通人也能用上天空辐射制冷涂料的巨大进步。

cues.en: I think the pigment made in this video is as good as anything available,
cues.zh: 我认为这个视频里做出的颜料，和现有任何产品一样好，

cues.en: even to scientists in commercial laboratories.
cues.zh: 甚至对商业实验室的科学家来说也是如此。

cues.en: But that does not mean there's no more room for improvement.
cues.zh: 但这并不意味着没有改进空间。

cues.en: I've barely scratched the surface of what kinds of sealants, silicones, adhesives,
cues.zh: 我才刚刚开始探索哪些密封剂、硅酮、胶粘剂、

cues.zh: 聚合物

cues.en: that this pigment could be mixed with and still achieve the same or even better cooling.
cues.zh: 能与这种颜料混合，并且仍达到相同甚至更好的制冷效果。

cues.en: There are endless experiments to try.
cues.zh: 有无穷无尽的实验可以尝试。

cues.zh: 现在你们都知道怎么做高性能颜料了，
